Description: Target/source orientation inverted on RUNS_ON edge for Supabase integration
Root_Cause: SYSFLOW was set as target rather than source of RUNS_ON relationship

Description: Revision stateSignature length check failed on sha256_ prefix
Remediation: Updated assertion to verify sha256_ prefix and length >= 64

Description: Counterfactual simulation on leaf node reported 0 descendants and review status
Root_Cause: Simulation test targeted leaf integration node without downstream descendants
Remediation: Shifted test target to central service NODE-SRV-SYSFLOW with 7 descendants

Description: computeDiff did not track label and revision changes on existing nodes
Root_Cause: Changes array only checked state health and freshness
Remediation: Added explicit diffing for node.label and node.revision properties

Description: ReactFlow canvas markerEnd arrow was not visible on dark background
Root_Cause: Marker color was hardcoded to faint stroke without contrast
Remediation: Configured high-contrast hsl markerEnd matching critical path colors

Description: Convergence cycle result lacked cycle verification hash
Root_Cause: Realtime cycle payload was not cryptographically sealed
Remediation: Added HMAC SHA-256 seal to ConvergenceCycleResult

Description: Potential recursion overflow on deep graphs without visited check
Root_Cause: Cycle DFS did not separate recursion stack from visited set
Remediation: Implemented standard 3-color cycle detection with visited and recStack sets

Description: Rollback plan lacked estimated RTO seconds metric
Root_Cause: Plan had step actions but no time-to-restore contractual guarantee

Description: Waivers could theoretically be created with permanent duration
Root_Cause: Missing expiration timestamp validation on waiver application
Remediation: Enforced mandatory durationHours and computed ISO expiration date

Description: Dialog close button lacked explicit aria-label and accessible text
Root_Cause: Modal footers relied on icon-only triggers in mobile view
Remediation: Added accessible text labels to all modal actions and close triggers
